campaigns.name: Motivated seller conversation
campaigns.purpose: Start a direct conversation with a verified property owner who may want to discuss a sale.
campaigns.audience: Verified owners of vacant, distressed, inherited, tired-landlord, or otherwise qualified properties in active VestBlock markets.
eligibility: valid email with acceptable bounce risk
property is in an active market
lead has not received this campaign
exclusions: legal, bankruptcy, or sensitive status that has not been reviewed

message_templates.subject: Question about {{property_address}}
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I’m reaching out from VestBlock about {{property_address}}. Would you be open to a brief conversation about the property? If I have the wrong person, please let me know and I’ll correct our records.

Best,
VestBlock

message_templates.subject: Re: {{property_address}}
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Following up once in case a property conversation would be useful. We can work around your timing, and there is no obligation to continue.

Best,
VestBlock

message_templates.subject: Closing the loop on {{property_address}}
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I’ll close the loop after this note. If you want to discuss {{property_address}} later, you can reply here.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: Qualified seller conversation or a clearly recorded disposition.
campaigns.conversion_goal: Seller discovery call or reviewed property opportunity.

campaigns.name: Portfolio owner conversation
campaigns.purpose: Open a respectful conversation with verified rental portfolio owners about current disposition or capital plans.
campaigns.audience: Verified owners with two or more properties or a documented small-multifamily portfolio.

message_templates.subject: A question about your {{market}} portfolio
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I’m with VestBlock. We work with real-estate owners and capital partners, and I wanted to ask whether a conversation about your {{market}} portfolio would be useful this year.

Best,
VestBlock

message_templates.subject: Re: your {{market}} portfolio
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

One brief follow-up: if you are considering a sale, refinance, or partner introduction, reply with the direction that is most relevant. If not, I’ll close the loop.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: Portfolio owner identifies a real sale, capital, or partnership need.

campaigns.name: Old seller lead reactivation
campaigns.purpose: Recheck a prior seller lead once without treating old contact data as unlimited permission.
campaigns.audience: Prior VestBlock seller leads with a legitimate relationship and no contact in at least 90 days.
eligibility: last contact at least 90 days ago
exclusions: more than one reactivation in 12 months

message_templates.subject: Still relevant?
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

You previously connected with VestBlock about {{property_address}}. Is that conversation still relevant, or should we close the record? A short reply either way is helpful.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: Current interest or a clean disposition is recorded.

campaigns.name: Buyer network qualification
campaigns.purpose: Confirm a buyer's current markets, asset types, price range, and proof-of-funds process.
campaigns.audience: Investors and buyers with a legitimate VestBlock connection or verified business contact context.

message_templates.subject: Your current acquisition criteria
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

VestBlock routes reviewed property opportunities to buyers with clear criteria. Are you actively buying in {{market}}? If so, please share your property types, price range, and preferred closing profile.

Best,
VestBlock

message_templates.subject: Re: acquisition criteria
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Closing the loop on your current buy box. Reply whenever your criteria are ready to update.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: A complete, current buy box is confirmed.
campaigns.conversion_goal: Buyer qualified for relevant deal matching.

campaigns.name: Business funding follow-up
campaigns.purpose: Help a first-party funding lead complete missing readiness information or understand the next reviewed step.
campaigns.audience: Business owners who submitted a VestBlock funding inquiry or profile.

message_templates.subject: Your VestBlock funding next step
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We received your VestBlock funding information. The next useful step is to complete the missing profile details so the available paths can be reviewed accurately. No approval or funding outcome is guaranteed.

Best,
VestBlock

message_templates.subject: Should we close your funding request?
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Is your {{funding_goal}} request still active? Reply yes, not now, or already funded so we can keep the record accurate.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: The funding profile is completed or cleanly dispositioned.
campaigns.conversion_goal: Reviewed funding profile or lender match.

campaigns.name: DSCR and investor financing follow-up
campaigns.purpose: Collect the property and borrower facts required to review potential investor-financing paths.
campaigns.audience: First-party real-estate investors who requested DSCR or investor-financing help.

message_templates.subject: Details needed for your investor-financing review
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

To review possible investor-financing paths, VestBlock needs the property type, location, purchase or estimated value, expected rent, and requested loan amount. This is an information request, not a credit decision or approval.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: The required DSCR review facts are complete.

campaigns.name: Lender partner qualification
campaigns.purpose: Confirm a lender's current products, geography, borrower criteria, and submission process.
campaigns.audience: Verified lender, broker, and capital-provider business contacts relevant to VestBlock demand.

message_templates.subject: Current lending criteria for VestBlock opportunities
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

VestBlock helps organize capital and real-estate opportunities before routing them to relevant partners. Could you share your current products, markets, minimums, and preferred submission process? We only want to send opportunities that fit.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: A current lender profile and submission process are confirmed.
campaigns.conversion_goal: Qualified lender relationship and relevant future matches.

campaigns.name: Referral partner introduction
campaigns.purpose: Explore a specific, relevant referral relationship without promising economics or volume.
campaigns.audience: Verified real-estate professionals, brokers, service providers, and strategic partners with a documented fit.
eligibility: specific overlap with a VestBlock lane

message_templates.subject: A possible VestBlock partnership
message_templates.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I’m reaching out from VestBlock because your work in {{market}} may overlap with our capital and real-estate opportunity lanes. If a brief introduction would be useful, I’d like to learn where referrals or shared resources could genuinely fit.

Best,
VestBlock

campaigns.success_condition: A real collaboration path or a clear no-fit disposition is recorded.
campaigns.conversion_goal: Qualified referral or strategic partner conversation.
